history.name: Recording a change to a feature
history.description: The command ledger update replaces a feature's description with its full current-state text, and takes a list of change bullets alongside it. Each bullet says what the feature was before and why it moved, which is the part a reader cannot get from the description. A feature that existed before this release cannot be updated without one, so an edition never carries a changed entry with no reason attached.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/write.mjs cmdUpdate. add_changes appends instead of replacing. Category, sub-section and size moves apply to the feature rather than to one moment in its history; dev_notes carry forward to a new history entry on their own.
